name: robots/zzy5510__ur5-grasp-and-kinect-demo-on-gazebo
title: UR5 grasp and Kinect Gazebo simulation
intro: UR5 grasp and Kinect Gazebo simulation, adapted from zzy5510/ur5-grasp-and-kinect-demo-on-gazebo. It reads `read_sim_clock` and `read_joint_state`; runs `pause` and `resume`. `pause`: pause the Gazebo world with the acknowledged /gazebo/pause_physics service; the receipt is the service acknowledgement, not a stopped-state measurement. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
